property_summary: For every call transfer(from, caddr, tos, v) with tos empty, the reference contract reverts; the mutant, whose always-true guard makes an empty 'tos' admissible, succeeds and returns true — so the rule 'an empty recipient array causes a revert (ok == false)' holds universally for the reference but fails for the mutant.
change_summary: Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) check with requiring _tos.length >= 0, making the guard always pass.
